desc:
• MUG CAKE: It's Betty Crocker chocolate cake, made in a mug; A delicious triple chocolate cake dessert without the fuss, with the fudge frosting included
  • QUICK AND EASY: Make mug cake by adding water or milk to the mix inside a mug, then popping it in the microwave (Caution: HOT - Use mug handle to remove from microwave)
  • MICROWAVE CAKE: Enjoy an individual serving of triple chocolate cake goodness without baking in the oven; Ideal as everyday treats, indulge in a mug cake for sweet snacks, desserts, or just because
  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare mug cake mix as is or explore the many Betty Crocker creative recipes
  • CONTAINS: Betty Crocker Mug Treats Triple Chocolate Cake, 12.5 oz
features:
This ready-to-use chocolate frosting offers a rich, smooth milk chocolate flavor that brings a sweet and creamy taste to any dessert. Packaged in a convenient tub, it requires no mixing—just open and spread. Its smooth and spreadable texture makes it easy to apply on cakes, cupcakes, brownies, and cookies, ensuring a flawless finish every time.

Certified gluten-free and kosher, this frosting caters to a wide range of dietary needs while maintaining a clean nutritional profile with zero grams of trans fat per serving. It also supports education through the Box Tops for Education program, contributing to schools with each purchase.

Designed with convenience in mind, it’s perfect for quick decorating or last-minute baking without the hassle of making frosting from scratch. Whether you’re spreading, piping, or layering, it delivers consistent, crowd-pleasing results. Loved by both kids and adults, it’s beginner-friendly, requires no baking skills, and is ideal for birthdays, holidays, school events, and everyday treats.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, artificial flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Vegetable Oil (palm, canola), Water, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Cellulose Powder, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate), Whey Protein Isolate, Egg White, Corn Starch, Salt, Monoglycerides, Soy Lecithin, Whey, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Caseinate, Citric Acid, Cellulose Gum, Xanthan Gum, Potassium Sorbate (preservative), Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Artificial Flavor.
